title: Manual file upload
description: A human-uploaded artifact (PDF, screenshot, signed letter) cited as evidence. v1.1 adds the source fields the manual connector records for each path: row_index and payload_b64 for a local CSV row; bucket, etag and last_modified for an S3 object; host, remote_path and mtime for an SFTP file. All are optional, so a 1.0.0 payload is a valid 1.1.0 payload.

row_index.description: Local CSV path: the data row's index in the file.

payload_b64.description: Local CSV path: the row as a JSON object keyed by header, base64-encoded.

bucket.description: S3 path: the bucket holding the object.

etag.description: S3 path: the object's ETag when the connector read it.

last_modified.description: S3 path: the object's Last-Modified time, RFC 3339.

host.description: SFTP path: the server the file was read from.

remote_path.description: SFTP path: the file's full path on the server.

mtime.description: SFTP path: the file's modification time, RFC 3339 with nanoseconds.
